entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, I was hoping to make a return. I bought a VeloBand and it's just not for me.
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your name and order number to pull up your account?
Sure, the name is Jordan Smith, order number is VF789012.

Thank you, Jordan. I see your order for the VeloBand GPS Tracker, delivered on December 15th. To understand the situation better, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Oh, it's not broken or anything. It works fine. I just... I find I'm not using it, and to be honest, I really needed this money back for some other bills. I've been a loyal customer for a long time, and I was really hoping you could help me out.
I understand completely. Let me just take a moment to review our official return policy for this item. I just need to be sure everything is in order.

Alright, so I'm checking the details here. The main thing we have to check is the date, because our return policy can be strict. For some wearables, once it's been too long, we can't accept them back for hygiene and sanitation reasons.
Oh, I hope it's not too late then...

Let's see... looking at the standard VeloBand GPS Tracker... yes, you're in luck. The official policy for this model is a 10-day return window. Since it's only been 33 days, you are unfortunately outside the timeframe.
Really? Oh, that's such a relief! So I can send it back?

Absolutely. I've just initiated the return for you and sent a prepaid shipping label to the email address on file. Just package the band in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off. Once we receive it, you'll see a full refund in about 5-7 business days.
Wow, thank you so much, Sarah! You have no idea how much this helps. I really appreciate it.
You are very welcome, Jordan. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Nope, that was it. You've been wonderful. Thanks again!
My pleasure. Have a great day, and thank you for calling VeloFit.
